features: Reddit-style click and keyboard spoiler covers with hidden initial reading text.
Credited inline images and safe HTTPS source links.
Private full-reading previews that preserve the selected draft after sign-in.
Entry-bound interactive figures with owner-only writes, conditional versions and opaque-origin sandboxing.
Figures inherit the entry publication state and become private again on unpublish.

checks.result: 28 unit tests; production build; private-file bundle gate; 85 API assertions; real Next cloud regression gate.

checks.command: npx eslint [changed journal files] && npx tsc --noEmit

chrome: Anonymous private preview prompts sign-in without revealing the entry.
Following a draft link and signing in selects the requested entry; before the fix, the title stayed blank.
Click reveals a covered passage and its source; Space hides it again. Hidden names are absent from initial visible reading text.
Diagram controls function inside the private sandboxed iframe.
390px reading page has zero horizontal overflow and scrolls to the footer.
All four essay images load in the local reading view; the site-owned cover uses its current preview origin.
privacy: Authored content and compiled personal-use TinyCharts sheets remain outside the repository in private journal storage. No entry was published.

review.scope: Application changes: draft reads, figure write/read authorization, same-origin writes, stale versions, path validation, sandbox response headers and escaped rich content.

calibration.claim: Existing plain journal renderer needs explicit support for spoilers, credited figures and interactive charts
Private entry-bound figures can share owner authentication while isolating script execution
Sign-in must select the draft identified by the original entry link
Site-owned covers should resolve on the active preview origin
